newsitem.title: USA: Chicago Miniature unit to buy competitor.
newsitem.headline: Chicago Miniature unit to buy competitor.

text.p: Chicago Miniature Lamp Inc said on Tuesday that its German subsidiary signed a letter of intent to acquire Vimercati, an Italian competitor, for about $30 million.

The transaction, involvingf 100,000 shares of Chicago Miniature stock and 47.5 million marks, calls for the acquisition of Vimercati by Alba Speziallampen Holding GmbH, Chicago Miniature's subsidiary.
Vimercati is a direct competitor of Chicago Miniature in lamps and sockets to the automotive industry, Chicago Miniature said in a statement.

The company also said that if completed, the acquisition would enhance its total revenue by roughly $35 million in fiscal 1998 and raise targeted revenue projections to about $240 million for the same period.
